newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares up, seen steady to year-end.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares up, seen steady to year-end.

text.p: Austrian shares closed 0.65 percent higher on Friday as the expiry of December futures passed off without incident and traders said the ATX index had settled into a 1,120-1,130 points trading range.

The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares finished 7.23 points ahead at 1,127.45 in thin pre-holiday trade. December ATX futures went off the board 6.3 points up at 1,123.8, in line with market expectations.
"I don't expect an awful lot of activity next week. Most people have already closed their books," said a trader. "The ATX will probably end the year more or less where it is now."
Overall 17 shares were up and four down.
Creditanstalt preferred shares were the leading gainer, building on a recovery started half way through Thursday's session. The stock added on 9.09 schillings, or 2.08 percent, to end at 485.4.
Finance Minister Viktor Klima has promised a decision on the destiny of the state's 70 percent stake of Creditanstalt ordinary voting shares between Christmas and New Year.
Steel maker VA Stahl topped turnover, rising 2.05 schillings to 382 on volume of 72,448. Earlier the firm said it and Italy's Gabrielli group had acquired northern Italian steel firm Veneta Nastri.
Insurer Wiener Staedtische was the biggest decliner, slipping nine schillings, or 0.92 percent, to 970.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index closed 2.31 points up at 425.49. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
